card.name: Dollar signs and year digits
card.fires_on: The dollar sign before a monthly wage amount, the first digit '1' of an 1800s year in a birth-death span, and a comma inside a number. Also fires on 'bypass' or 'graft' in 'coronary artery bypass graft (CABG)'.
